protocol.py: 4 biology problems (3 warnings, 1 note).

1. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Mixing too weak to stir tube A2 in slot 3: 3 × 40 ul in 1220 ul
   line 48:  p300.aspirate(vol, src)
   reached through: run:75 > transfer_p300:48
   At line 48 the tip mixes tube A2 in slot 3 with 3 strokes of 40 ul in a well holding 1220
   ul. The well holds more than the p300_single_gen2 can draw, so the stroke is judged
   against the pipette's 300 ul. 3 strokes of 40 ul move 0.4 of the pipette's 300 ul in all;
   it takes about 2 pipette-fulls of strokes to mix (the mixing work). Integra draws over
   80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the
   well holds is not at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every
   later step inherits the error.
   Affected: tube A2 in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix with the pipette's full volume (300 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 300, well)`,
   or use a bigger pipette.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/3-simple-and-proven-automation-protocols-serial-dilutions-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   Source: Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
           https://research.fredhutch.org/content/dam/research/hahn/methods/Agencourt%20AMPure%20XP.pdf
   Source: Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
           https://escaautomation.substack.com/p/serial-dilution-a-classic-technique
   Source: labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
           https://labautomation.io/t/how-to-mix-bacteria-sample-enough/3654
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   [7af41e02a394]

2. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Mixing too weak to stir 19 wells: 2 × 48 ul in 60 ul
   line 51:  p300.mix(2, mix_vol, dest)
   reached through: run:75 > transfer_p300:51
   At line 51 the tip mixes tubes A3, A4, A5, A6, B2, B3, B4, B5 and 11 more in slot 3 with
   2 strokes of 48 ul in a well holding 60 ul (this line did it 19 times). 2 strokes of 48
   ul move 1.6 of the well in all; it takes about 2 wells' worth of strokes to mix (the
   mixing work). Fewer than 3 strokes do not mix a well. Integra draws over 80% of the well
   five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not
   at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits
   the error.
   Affected: tubes A3, A4, A5, A6, B2, B3, B4, B5 and 11 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix the well with about 80% of its volume (48 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 48,
   well)`. A stroke of the whole well draws air; use no more than 90%.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide

   At line 59 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2 and 16 more in slot 4 with

findings.title: Mixing too weak to stir tube A2 in slot 3: 3 × 40 ul in 1220 ul
findings.explanation: At line 48 the tip mixes tube A2 in slot 3 with 3 strokes of 40 ul in a well holding 1220 ul. The well holds more than the p300_single_gen2 can draw, so the stroke is judged against the pipette's 300 ul. 3 strokes of 40 ul move 0.4 of the pipette's 300 ul in all; it takes about 2 pipette-fulls of strokes to mix (the mixing work). Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
findings.fix: Mix with the pipette's full volume (300 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 300, well)`, or use a bigger pipette.

findings.title: Mixing too weak to stir 19 wells: 2 × 48 ul in 60 ul
findings.explanation: At line 51 the tip mixes tubes A3, A4, A5, A6, B2, B3, B4, B5 and 11 more in slot 3 with 2 strokes of 48 ul in a well holding 60 ul (this line did it 19 times). 2 strokes of 48 ul move 1.6 of the well in all; it takes about 2 wells' worth of strokes to mix (the mixing work). Fewer than 3 strokes do not mix a well. Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
findings.fix: Mix the well with about 80% of its volume (48 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 48, well)`. A stroke of the whole well draws air; use no more than 90%.
